challenges.says: The second criterion adds a condition the cited rule does not state ("when the commit is not itself tagged") and uses the term "describe command", which a product owner who never saw the code cannot follow; the rule says only a tag, commit count and short commit name when tags exist, and a short commit name otherwise.

The what and the term "Build version" say the version is shown or reported by the screens and the service, but the cited rule only stamps the version into a file and no reviewed input shows it displayed anywhere.
